name: Plinio Needs a Hand
detailed_description:
Welcome to a charming and whimsical world, where physics bends to its own rules, and a quirky family of slimes embarks on a journey through five extraordinary levels. In a realm where the surreal becomes routine, meet the slime adventurer family: a robust green father, a delicate pink mother, and a lighter-than-air daughter in soft shades of pink. They've conquered every nook of this peculiar universe, from the foundations to unexplored heights.

Yet, a fateful day turns their journey into an exciting saga. Returning home, a malevolent creature cuts the bridge connecting levels, causing the father slime to plummet to the lowest tier. Desperate to reunite with his beloved family, he stands at the edge of an impassable precipice.

This is where players step in, summoned to guide our slime hero through intriguing challenges using the magic of our hands. Manipulate boxes, unravel puzzles, and forge a path through each level as the captivating narrative unfolds.

Game Features:
🌈 Surreal World: Explore vibrant levels filled with surprises, where each layer unveils new challenges and wonders.
🤯 Innovative Puzzles: Master the art of manipulating boxes controlled by your hand to create passages through intriguing obstacles.
👾 Malevolent Creatures: Encounter and interact with unfriendly creatures whose mission is to hinder our hero.
👪 Family Bonds: Immerse yourself in the exciting story of a slime family, gathering them and overcoming challenges to restore harmony.
💡 Fun and Challenging Physics: Test your skills with a unique game mechanic that challenges the laws of physics in unexpected and stimulating ways.

Get ready for a unique and unforgettable adventure, where your dexterity and imagination are the keys to reuniting this adorable family. Embark now on a journey of puzzles and discoveries in a world where even the simplest slimes can become extraordinary heroes.
